title: Treasury reserve margin learned on the fitted real-time Taylor rule
description: The same fictional floating-rate treasury as monetary-treasury-stress, now choosing a reserve margin each quarter from what it observed last quarter. Episodes resample contiguous two-year blocks of the first-release quarters the validated attempt was fitted on, and draw policy shocks from the fitted residual distribution. The mechanism is validated; the treasury, its costs and its tolerance are invented.

decision_maker.role: Treasury of a floating-rate borrower; takes the policy rate as given
decision_maker.description: Fictional. Its reserve decision does not move the policy rate.

reserve_margin.description: Reserve next quarter's interest at the last observed quarterly policy rate plus this margin.

policy_rate_reaction.description: Quarterly smoothed Taylor rule fitted to first-release FEDFUNDS, CPI and CBO output gap (monetary family).

does_not_establish: Training and evaluation episodes resample the same 1995-2024 first-release quarters the mechanism was fitted on; held-out seeds are held-out draws, not held-out history.
Resampling history assumes the next two years look like a block of the last thirty.
